management_http_port.description: HTTP port for the RabbitMQ Management Plugin web UI and API.

management_bind_address.description: Network interface (IP address) to bind the management HTTP(S) listeners to. Use '0.0.0.0' to accept connections on all interfaces.

management_ssl_enabled.description: Enable HTTPS for the management interface. Requires valid SSL certificate and key files.

management_https_port.description: HTTPS port for the RabbitMQ Management Plugin (only used if SSL is enabled).

management_ssl_cacertfile.description: Path to the CA certificate file for TLS verification (used if SSL is enabled).

management_ssl_certfile.description: Path to the server certificate file (used if SSL is enabled).

management_ssl_keyfile.description: Path to the server private key file (used if SSL is enabled).

management_ssl_verify.description: Whether to require and verify client certificates. 'verify_peer' enforces client certificate validation.

management_agent.description: Authentication backend. Do not change unless you are using a custom auth plugin.

management_num_tcp_acceptors.description: Number of TCP acceptor processes for handling management connections.

management_http_timeout.description: HTTP request timeout in milliseconds. Increase for long-running requests (e.g., large queue dumps).

management_disable_guest_login.description: Block the default 'guest' user from logging in via the HTTP API/UI (recommended for production).

management_metrics.description: List of key-value pairs for fine-grained metric collection tuning (e.g., enable/disable specific metrics).

management_log_levels.description: Log levels to enable for the management plugin (e.g., ['error', 'warning', 'info', 'debug']). Order matters: first match wins.

management_path_prefix.description: URL path prefix for the management plugin (e.g., '/rmq-mgmt'). Leave as '/' for default.

management_rate_limiting_enabled.description: Enable request rate limiting for the management API to prevent abuse.

management_rate_limit_threshold.description: Max number of requests allowed per interval before rate limiting kicks in (used if rate limiting is enabled).

management_rate_limit_interval_ms.description: Time window in milliseconds for rate limiting (used if rate limiting is enabled).

management_cluster_name.description: Custom display name for the RabbitMQ cluster in the UI. If empty, uses the node name.

management_ppi_enabled.description: Enable Performance & Predictability Insights (PPI) data collection. Sends anonymized metrics to RabbitMQ team (opt-in).
